createWorld.customize.maze_world.title: Maze World Customization
createWorld.customize.maze_world.heading: General
Enabled Dimensions
Maze generator
createWorld.customize.maze_world.infinit: Prevents the player from going above or below the walls in worlds without a ceiling by rejecting movement packets that cross the maze walls
mazeworld.maze_type.binary_tree.descript:
A very simple algorithm with a bias to make diagonal corridors
The threshold controls the ratio of horizontal and vertical corridors.
mazeworld.maze_type.wang_tiles.descripti:
Makes a maze by filling in matching random tiles. This can generate corridors not connected to anything.
The threshold controls the ratio of the wall and corridor width.
mazeworld.maze_type.round_wang_tiles.des:
Makes a rounded off maze by filling in matching random tiles. This can generate corridors not connected to anything.
The threshold controls the ratio of the wall and corridor width.
mazeworld.maze_type.simplex_noise.descri: Makes a maze by comparing a 2D noise map by the set threshold value.
mazeworld.maze_type.simplex_noise_3d.des: Makes a maze by comparing a 3D noise map by the set threshold value. This generates bedrock caves through the whole world.
mazeworld.structure_replacement.replace_: The maze walls may replace all structures. This may make it impossible to open the end portal.
mazeworld.structure_replacement.preserve: Prevents maze walls from cutting through the end portal room in the stronghold.
Prevents maze walls from cutting through any bounding box of a structure piece.
